name: LOD showcase
description: The LOD system lane by lane (docs/plans/_DONE_p351_impostor-billboard-lod.md Phase 5): each lane runs away from the start camera along -z, with an object in every level band. Left to right: an instanced tree pool ending in exported cross-quads and a cull fade; hand-made levels in JSON; a generated chain (AUTO); a pool ending in an exported octahedral impostor; a rock impostor baked and exported side by side; a static instance cell. Debug env: the scene's own "LOD demo" tab.
